title: GET /dashboard
description: D1: agent summaries with environment, effective mode, and P&L (paper labeled simulated); counts of open approvals and unread alerts; and the event ids of recent gate decisions. Their content is at their own routes. docs/specs/workspace-api.md §4.7, §4.10 (DEC-741).

as_of.description: API-14: a read model names every stream it read, so its watermarks are never empty.

recent_decisions.description: Gate-decision event ids, newest first; each is read at GET /journal/events/{id}/gate (§4.8).
